title: Change your name on an E-Toll Account
summary: Learn how to update your name on a Transport for NSW E-Toll Account after a name change.
intro:
If you need to update your Transport for NSW E-Toll Account because of a name change (due to marriage, for example) you'll need to visit a Service NSW Centre.

The account cannot be transferred into the name of another person.
who_can_apply: You need to update your Transport for NSW E-Toll Account because of a name change (e.g., due to marriage).

faqs.q: Where do I go to change my name on an E-Toll Account?
faqs.a: You must visit a Service NSW Centre.

faqs.q: Can I transfer my E-Toll Account into someone else's name?
faqs.a: No, the account cannot be transferred into the name of another person.
